name: Bitculator Data API
description: Crypto market data API with prices averaged across 16 exchanges, OHLCV history, a Fear & Greed index per coin, technical indicators, exchanges with trust scores and liquidations.
notes: Public REST API with a free plan of 10,000 requests a month, an OpenAPI 3 spec, decimal-string prices and official MIT SDKs in 8 languages (github.com/Bitculator). Useful for agents that need crypto prices, sentiment and exchange data. Disclosure: submitted by the maker.
